papers.title_en: BlindPSNR: A No-Reference Fidelity Predictor for Low-Light Image Enhancement
papers.authors: Mingzhe Lyu, Jinqiang Cui, Hong Zhang
papers.evidence: 无参考质量预测方法，可迁移至视频质量评估
papers.tldr: 低光图像增强方法参数固定，手动调参耗时，PSNR需参考图而已有NR-IQA针对感知质量，七个基线选择准确率为0%。BlindPSNR轻量网络，用窗口交叉注意力融合增强图与低光输入，异方差回归预测PSNR。top-1准确率由54.4%提升至89.5%，遗憾从1.62dB降至0.026dB，并泛化到未知数据集，为LLIE自动参数选择提供有效方案。
papers.abstract_en: Low-light image enhancement (LLIE) methods involve tunable parameters that are typically fixed, often leading to performance degradation when applied across scenes. Manually selecting the best configuration, however, can be time-consuming and not always practical. Peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR) is the natural fidelity criterion for automating parameter selection, yet it requires a ground-truth reference that is typically unavailable. To our knowledge, no learning-based method addresses no-reference PSNR prediction for low-light image enhancement; the natural surrogate, no-reference image quality assessment (NR-IQA), targets perceptual quality rather than signal fidelity, and all seven baselines we test achieve 0% top-1 selection accuracy on our benchmark. With paired training data, the ground-truth PSNR is analytically computable, providing exact supervision without a separate teacher network. Building on this, we propose BlindPSNR, a lightweight no-reference network that fuses the enhanced image with the degraded low-light input via windowed cross-attention and estimates PSNR through heteroscedastic regression. While a scalar-regression baseline achieves top-1 accuracy of 54.4%, BlindPSNR raises this to 89.5% with regret dropping from 1.62 dB to 0.026 dB, and generalizes to unseen datasets (SRCC = 0.61-0.67).

papers.title_en: Scaling Properties of Text Conditioning in Visual Generation
papers.authors: Zilong Chen, Chaorui Deng, Kunchang Li, Hongyi Yuan, Haoqi Fan
papers.evidence: 采用GPG与ED指标量化提示中的结构化语言，并将其与扩散损失关联
papers.tldr: 文本条件视觉生成中，扩散损失并不随提示词数量自然缩放，其与提示中结构化语言的量密切相关。本文采用白盒似然度GPG与黑盒属性度量ED两种互补指标，发现收敛扩散损失随GPG近似线性下降、随ED呈幂律关系。据此通过构造含语义与几何注释的结构化提示提升可扩散性，并训练prompter提升可提示性。系统在多数组合、推理与世界知识基准上超越开源模型，追平或超过最强闭源模型。
papers.abstract_en: We study empirical scaling properties for text conditioning in visual generation. Such properties have rarely been measured because diffusion loss does not scale with the number of tokens in natural-language prompts. Surprisingly, we find that the converged diffusion loss scales with the amount of structured language in the prompt. To quantify structured language, we adapt two complementary measures: a white-box likelihood metric (GPG) and a black-box attribute metric (ED). Across controlled training runs, the converged diffusion loss decreases approximately linearly with GPG and follows a power law with ED. Guided by these scaling properties, we improve \emph{diffusability} by constructing structured prompts with semantic and geometric annotations derived from images, and improve \emph{promptability} by training a prompter through supervised fine-tuning, cold-start, and verifier-gated on-policy distillation. The resulting system outperforms all evaluated open-weight models on nearly every compositional, reasoning, and world-knowledge benchmark, while matching or surpassing the strongest closed-weight models on most evaluations.
